about: Lesson 1.08 case set: 24 inbox emails, each with a gold triage record, the record the stand-in model intends (three named judgement errors: rec-07 label, rec-13 priority, rec-16 due), and the form defects the lab applies when serialising. Summaries are graded on the printed key phrase; all other fields exact.
